summary: A young man holds the camera in selfie mode while walking up tiled stairs in a subway station with other commuters behind him.

people.description: Young East Asian man with wavy black hair, wearing an unbuttoned brown shirt, thin chain necklace, and backpack, filming himself on the move; other passengers walk behind him.

quality.issues: slight walking bounce and motion blur

moments.action: Creator walks up the subway exit stairs filming a front-facing selfie while looking into the lens
good_for: on my way to see you
